relation_to_canonical: post-canonical preregistered expansion; H1-H4 thresholds from protocol_v1 remain unchanged
purpose: Quantify when positive occurrences can identify a known virtual process and when alternative processes are observationally indistinguishable.
exact_cases: Each of the 16 process worlds is treated once as truth within each of 4 landscapes, subject only to source viability and >=2 reachable states.

sampling.seed_rule: deterministic SHA-256 derived from landscape_id, truth_world_id, coverage and replicate index

preregistered_hypotheses.claim: A true world is uniquely identifiable from positive occurrences if and only if the observed positive set intersects the truth-only witness set of every false candidate world.
preregistered_hypotheses.test: Exact set comparison against EOG compatible-world output for every factorial replicate.
preregistered_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any mismatch refutes the criterion implementation.

preregistered_hypotheses.claim: With noiseless positive sampling and truth included, increasing positive-occurrence coverage cannot reduce the probability of unique truth identification when sampling is coupled by nested positive sets.
preregistered_hypotheses.test: Use nested deterministic sampling order within each replicate; identification indicator must be non-decreasing across coverage levels.

preregistered_hypotheses.claim: If at least one false world has the same reachable positive state as truth, full positive observation cannot uniquely identify truth.
preregistered_hypotheses.test: At coverage=1.0, every exact reachable-set equivalent false world must remain compatible.
preregistered_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any equivalent false world eliminated by positive-only compatibility refutes F3.

preregistered_hypotheses.claim: Omitting the true world is not guaranteed to falsify the candidate universe; a false candidate that contains all true positive states can remain compatible.
preregistered_hypotheses.test: Remove truth, expose the complete true positive state, and classify whether the remaining universe falsifies or survives.
preregistered_hypotheses.interpretation: This is a boundary hypothesis. Both outcomes are expected across cases; the required result is that survival occurs whenever a remaining candidate is a positive-state superset of truth and falsification occurs only when every remaining candidate has a positive witness against it.

language_boundary.cpp_trigger: same as protocol_v1: >60 s CI wall-clock or >1 GiB peak memory at target workload

forbidden_after_results: drop a landscape family because it is hard to identify
exclude observationally equivalent worlds from the denominator
change nested sampling rule to improve monotonicity
port to C++ solely because Python result is scientifically unfavorable
